  • Method Details

    • schema

      default Map<String,Object> schema(Type type)
      Describes type completely, or returns null to leave it to the next contributor and the default Java model. Generated formats use this instead of exposing implementation fields that never appear on their wire.

    • used

      default void used(Type type)
      Told of every type a schema is asked for, whichever contributor describes it. Lets a contributor that only adds to another's schemas, through componentContributions(), know which types are in the document.

    • componentContributions

      default Map<String,Object> componentContributions()

    • operationFor

      default OpenApiOperationContribution operationFor(Class<?> handlerClass)

    • name

      default String name(Field field)
      The name field has on the wire, or null to leave it to another contributor or the field.

    • ignored

      default boolean ignored(Field field)
      Whether field is left out of what is written.

    • property

      default boolean property(Field field, Map<String,Object> schema)
      Adds to one property's schema what the code already says elsewhere — a validation engine's rules, a format's read-only or write-only access. Returns true when the property is required.

      Called while a type's schema is built, once per document revision.
